assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are characterized by palpitations
The symptoms are characterized by lightheadedness
The telemetry is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The telemetry is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
The patient has the right to appeal this determination
